author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am pushing to automate the hand over from the evaluation harness to the registry. Right now we wait for a human to trigger the update, which creates a lag between when fresh weather data lands and when the model sees it. I want that step to fire automatically the moment the new data is available. The more frequently the registry reflects the latest inputs, the better our feature tests become. Manual steps introduce delay and error, so removing them is the goal here. I see no downside to making this fully automated, and I am eager to see the system respond to live data without any waiting.
output.reclassify_reason: The author expresses a strong desire for immediate automation to eliminate delays and improve feature testing, indicating that increasing the frequency of registry updates would make them happier.
